verdict.rationale: The evidence shows RevenueCat's MCP server and AI toolkit let an AI assistant manage individual Products, Entitlements, and Offerings, and server-side import of existing purchase data exists, but nothing describes batch/bulk operations across many items at once (e.g., bulk-editing many products, mass customer updates, or batch API calls) for an AI-native workflow. Missing for full credit: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints, documentation of bulk operations via MCP/AI toolkit, and any example of operating on many items simultaneously.
